IGS Secure

IGS Secure

Driving smarter, faster public service capability, capacity and transformation

IGS Secure provides trusted support to UK policing, law enforcement agencies, Overseas Territories, and UK-funded international programmes. We deliver hands-on change, build operational capability, and deploy experienced professionals into sensitive, high-pressure settings. Whether the need is strategic reform, live operations support or secure capacity building - we bring discretion, credibility and delivery discipline.

Our approach to delivery:

We understand the critical nature of demand and time-sensitive requirements, both nationally and internationally. Our unique surge capability model allows us to deploy resources rapidly, ensuring you achieve maximum capacity and capability precisely when you need it most.

Our leadership and values:

Our management team brings over 60 years of combined operational policing experience, complemented by extensive leadership in and management of multi-million-pound government contracts across more than 26 countries. We are committed to delivering high trust, integrity, and transparency in all our partnerships. By working collaboratively with you, our goal is to enhance your existing capacity and capability, ensuring successful outcomes.

Our capabilities

Policing & Law Enforcement Reform

We support the design and delivery of modern, effective policing models aligned with UK standards. Our work helps forces improve accountability, strengthen operations and build public trust.

Learn more

Investigation & Intelligence Capability

We deploy experienced professionals to support live and historic investigations across all disciplines. From major crime to SOC, we bring practical expertise that improves outcomes and protects integrity.

Learn more

Overseas Programmes & Secure Capacity Building

We deliver UK-funded reform programmes in international contexts, tailored to each environment. This includes policing, governance, and security sector reform - grounded in local nuance, backed by UK credibility.

Learn more

Operational Performance & Managed Services

We partner closely to improve frontline performance and deliver full-service managed teams. That includes oversight, QA, risk monitoring, and workforce support - especially in complex or volatile environments.

Learn more

Law Enforcement Training & Capability Development

We design and deliver bespoke training aligned with UK College of Policing standards in line with APP. Our expert trainers raise capability, improve confidence, and leave behind sustained impact - not dependency.

Learn more

Sensitive & Complex
Review

Tailored, impartial reviews of high-risk, sensitive and complex matters across the public and private sector. Specialising in serious and organised crime (SOC) reviews, post-incident assurance, insider threat evaluations and investigations, conduct, governance or concerns.

Learn more

Meet the team

IGS Secure delivers critical capability where it counts - led by professionals who’ve served at the sharp end of policing and national security. Our network includes chief officers, senior investigators, HOLMES experts, and specialists in intelligence, cyber, financial crime, surveillance, roads policing, K9 units, and marine operations.

All have recent experience across UK policing, the Home Office, NCA, FCDO, and other ministerial departments. That operational currency, combined with disciplined delivery, ensures fast, effective results in sensitive and complex environments.
